height.$description: dimension used by the input component for height (MarsUI Input_field md cell: min-height 40px; consume as min-block-size so the field can grow).

min-target.$description: dimension used by the input component for min target.

padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for padding inline.

gap.$description: dimension used by the input component for gap.

label-gap.$description: dimension used by the input component for label gap.

label-padding-inline.$description: dimension used by the input component for label padding inline (MarsUI Input_label row 2px inset aligning the label ink with the cell radius).

hint-fg.$description: color used by the input component for the hint row foreground (MarsUI Hint_label Text/med_em; the hint row itself is pending its founder-gated API addition).

radius.$description: dimension used by the input component for radius (MarsUI Radius/component/radius_md 10px, the md Input_cell binding; component ramp so personality modes reach it).

icon-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for icon size.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for font size.

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the input component for font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for line height.

font-size.$description: dimension used by the input component for label font size (MarsUI UI/Para/medium: body_1 13px).

font-weight.$description: font weight used by the input component for label font weight.

line-height.$description: dimension used by the input component for label line height (MarsUI line_height/para 20px).

border-width.$description: dimension used by the input component for border width (MarsUI Input_cell stroke: 1px hairline; the border color stays ki.outline.control per the 2026-07-25 declared a11y deviation).

width.$description: dimension used by the input component for border block start width.
dimension used by the input component for border block end width.
dimension used by the input component for border inline start width.
dimension used by the input component for border inline end width.

bg.$description: color used by the input component for rest background (MarsUI Input_field rest fill Surface/s2: the fill identifies the field, not the outline).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for rest border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for rest placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for hover background (MarsUI hover = s2 + Black/3 overlay; s3 is the nearest token).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for hover border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for hover placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for focus background (MarsUI active state switches the fill to Surface/Special white / dark s2 — modeled with the scheme ladder s0).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for focus border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for focus placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled background.

fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled foreground (MarsUI disabled text Text/base_em; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).

border.$description: color used by the input component for disabled border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled label foreground.

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for disabled placeholder foreground.

hint-fg.$description: color used by the input component for the disabled hint row foreground (MarsUI disabled ladder Text/base_em; disabled cells are exempt from the contrast sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly background (retires the deprecated ki.surface.raised alias; same resolved value).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for readonly border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for readonly placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

bg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid background (MarsUI danger state keeps the white active fill; the ring and hint carry the signal).

fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid foreground.

border.$description: color used by the input component for invalid border.

label-fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid label foreground (MarsUI label is Text/med_em in every non-disabled state — active and danger included; the danger signal lives in the hint).

placeholder-fg.$description: color used by the input component for invalid placeholder foreground (MarsUI placeholder Text/low_em; placeholder is not the accessible name, so it sits outside the 4.5:1 text sweep).

ring.$description: shadow used by the input component for the persistent invalid ring (MarsUI Focus/danger: 3px danger-500 alpha spread; applied as box-shadow while :state(user-invalid)).

hint-fg.$description: color used by the input component for the invalid hint row foreground (MarsUI Hint_label danger: Text/danger_high_em carries the signal).

color.$description: color used by the input component for focus ring color.

width.$description: dimension used by the input component for focus ring width.

offset.$description: dimension used by the input component for focus ring offset.

shadow.$description: shadow used by the input component for the focus ring glow (MarsUI Focus/primary: 3px spread ring at 20% — see ki.focus.primary. specs/002-ki-button/design-extraction.md §2.5 recorded 40%, having read the alpha off the Dark canvas mode, same double mechanism as ki-button: glow plus the opaque indicator).
